headline: FIS makes its AML Investigations Agent available to any U.S. bank
body: FIS announced that its AML Investigations Agent, developed with support from Anthropic, is now commercially available to any U.S.-based bank, including those that are not FIS clients today. At Amalgamated Bank, a design partner, the agent is projected to reduce Level 2 case investigation time by approximately 98 percent, based on the bank's analysis of its current workflows.
note: The projection comes from Amalgamated's own analysis of its workflows, so the detail to watch is whether banks outside FIS's client base report their own numbers.

evidence.text: Developed by FIS with support from Anthropic, the FIS AML Agent is now commercially available to any U.S.-based bank, including those that are not FIS clients today.

At Amalgamated Bank, one of FIS’ design partners, the agent is projected to reduce Level 1 alert review time by more than 90 percent and Level 2 case investigation time by approximately 98 percent - referring respectively to initial alert triage and deeper case review after escalation - as well as SAR narrative preparation time by more than 80 percent, based on the bank’s analysis of its current workflows against the agent’s capabilities.
